annotation.title_clean: الميثاق الوطني لأخلاقيات الذكاء الاصطناعي (The National Artificial Intelligence Code of Ethics)
annotation.title_en: The National Artificial Intelligence Code of Ethics
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship (Jordan)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship, Jordan
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Jordan's bilingual (Arabic/English) voluntary National AI Code of Ethics issued by the Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship. It sets principles on humanity, inclusiveness, privacy, transparency, accountability, reliability, integrity and green AI, plus metaverse and research ethics, and recommends adoption, awareness, accreditation and a complaints channel.
key_provisions_or_claims: Eight ethical principles: humanity and society, inclusiveness and justice, privacy and data, transparency, accountability, reliability, integrity, green AI
Accountability for AI harms must attach to natural persons, not the technical system
Humans retain right to human intervention in AI decisions; human control should prevail in metaverse
Ministry to receive complaints on AI ethics and assess harm
Voluntary adoption encouraged via compliance officers, awards/accreditation, curricula integration and awareness campaigns
